corpus_recipe: Exact nonempty text deduplication over passages then hard_negatives in record order; canonical IDs FRP000001 onward.

sampling.policy: Uniform without replacement; first record per upstream question_id; seed and selected IDs frozen per run.

changes: Upstream files unmodified. Global text catalog only assigns stable passage IDs offline. Each run writes 30 isolated, shuffled question-specific supporting-plus-hard-negative packs, one Add per question. No QA or relevance labels enter Add; Search uses the original question without gold answers or query_rewrite.
metrics: Recall@1/5/10/20, MRR, nDCG@10 on independently verified original passage matches within each isolated question world. Unmapped evidence retains rank positions. This is not the native full-ranking baseline, global-corpus retrieval or full-filing retrieval.
